value.rationale: The all-size sign boundary answers a motivated question about adding ordinary agents to a fixed-leader social network. The distinction between increasing correlation and sometimes decreasing covariance is structurally informative, and the exact nonzero common-fluctuation limit contrasts with shrinking pairwise opinion differences. The threshold is invariant to the split of the stubborn camps, making a reusable analytic benchmark rather than an isolated parameter substitution. No empirical interpretation beyond the mathematical model is claimed.
